title: Dressed-Up Family with Young Girls, 1962 B&W Snapshot Photo
description: A candid black-and-white snapshot capturing a family of four posed outdoors, stamped NOV 62 along the border. In the foreground, two young girls are dressed up: one in a checkered gingham dress with a brimmed bonnet tied under her chin, and the other holding a baton. Behind them stands a woman wearing a vintage pillbox hat, glasses, and a dark sleeveless top, alongside a man standing in shadow near foliage and a textured building exterior.
